context:
Goal: the merge tool backs off when the GitHub quota runs low, without opening a way to merge a blocked PR.
Problem (risk): PR #3288 failed round 3 review with a small negative net safety value, so it is held (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3). The back-off can delay the final merge call by up to 15 minutes after the BLOCKED/BEHIND check. A PR that turns BLOCKED in that window could be merged by the admin-bypass token. A held change gets no fix lane and no more work until you decide. My earlier pick (wait for GitHub's reset time, step gh-quota-budget) did not say where the wait may sit; that gap is what round 3 found.
Based on (measured): the reviewer's probe on a scratch copy with the quota at 20 of 5000: PR read, wait 900 s, then the merge call; main sends the merge call within milliseconds. Lane gh-quota-budget's account via its message 17:19 CST Nov 13; triage has not read the review. Past rulings: hold-unsafe-after-round-3 and pr-review-record (round 4 needs your grant).
Departs from: main — main sends the merge call right after the check; the branch can wait first.
Meanwhile: the lane waits and does nothing more; the quota back-off does not ship.
home: PR #3288; step gh-quota-budget; decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3; lane gh-quota-budget (session_013NEJKzVtYq71orELDCuDRV)

options.label: Start a fix lane at round 1 for one change: hold only before the PR read, never between it and the merge call (Recommended)
Park the PR as it is
options.lose: The quota back-off does not ship.

reply: Filed as ruling own-780-c-round-4-3288 and sent to the lane through the coordinator. The grant covers PR #3288 and the one held defect only.
short: Quota back-off PR held at round 3: fix lane, park, or round 4?
title: PR #3288 (quota back-off) is held after round 3: start a fix lane, park it, or grant round 4?
why: A held change waits for your word; round 3 found the wait could let a blocked PR through the admin-bypass token.
